title: chaerophyllum brevipes
intro: Chaerophyllum brevipes, commonly known as Short-fruited Chervil, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. It is a member of the carrot family (Apiaceae) and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chaerophyllum brevipes include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestive health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily coumarins and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
